title: Keep for one round
note: Actual strip data-act keepfor:1; distinct sibling of keepfor:n. Proposed asset key, not a registry command.

title: Keep for N rounds
note: Actual strip data-act keepfor:n; distinct sibling of keepfor:1. Proposed asset key, not a registry command.

title: Lasts one round
note: Actual existing-template strip data-act rounds:1; mutually exclusive mode with keepfor:1, may share its painting. Proposed asset key, not a registry command.
